d: CloudEngine S5735-L16P2UM2X-QA-V2 - 16 × Gigabit PoE+ access ports, 2 × 10G Multigig PoE++ ports, 2 × 10G SFP+ uplinks, 247 W PoE budget, fanless Layer 3 managed access switch.

specs.label: Layer 2 features
specs.value: VLAN, Voice VLAN, STP, RSTP, MSTP, Link Aggregation (LACP - IEEE 802.3ad), LLDP / LLDP-MED / CDP, Port mirroring (SPAN)

specs.label: Layer 3 features
specs.value: Static routing, RIP, OSPF, EIGRP, Policy-based routing (PBR), IPv4 / IPv6 Dual Stack

specs.label: Performance & reliability
specs.value: Non-blocking architecture, Enterprise-grade MTBF, Fanless / Ruggedized Build

specs.label: Multicast
specs.value: IGMP v1, IGMP v2, IGMP v3, IGMP Snooping, PIM Sparse Mode (PIM-SM), Source-Specific Multicast (SSM)

specs.label: QoS (Quality of service)
specs.value: Hardware-based QoS at wire speed, Traffic classification & marking (CoS / DSCP), Priority queuing for voice & video, Policing, shaping, CIR, Up to 8 egress queues per port, Queue Management, DSCP Support
